correctness.rationale: Take complete odd-length binary palindrome layers at L_1=5 and L_(k+1)=2L_k+3. No fixed-length binary palindrome AP exists: if consecutive differences have valuation j, mirrored least/highest differing digits force the middle term to have both bit values at position j. When y,z have common length L=2h+1 and x=2y−z lies in (0,2^h), endpoint gaps of size 2^h force y=2^(L−1)+1, z=2^L−1 and x=3. In a mixed-length selected AP y,z necessarily same layer as z<2y, while x is shorter than 2^h but min selected length5 excludes x=3; impossible. At N=2^L−1, layer contains 2^h palindromes and total length<=L has 3*2^h−2, so limsup relative density≥1/3. Independent no-3AP brute checks for full layers 3..19 and selected lengths 5 and13 agree; infinite proof is structural.
